headline: US Blockade Reduces Iran Floating Oil Inventory to Zero
summary: Iran's floating crude inventory has fallen to zero under a U.S. naval blockade. The action threatens to stop Iran's oil export revenues completely by mid-December.
why: Iran is a member of OPEC and a global crude oil exporter whose output impacts world energy balances.
why_moved: Enforcement of a blockade curbing Iranian crude supplies elevates risk premiums and supply disruption concerns in global benchmark crude markets.
